unmeasured.why: EdgeDesk’s position-group player layer is college-only. There is no NFL unit grade in this repo, so the trench and coverage sections report the trench and coverage facts the NFL model does carry — sacks taken, sacks generated, EPA allowed by phase, explosive rates — and claim nothing beyond them.
